delta: Initial method catalogue; one evaluation method per pass.

methods.prerequisites: Documented user role and goal
methods.inspect: Map required subtasks, inputs and success conditions; compare them to visible actions
methods.evidence: Goal-to-action map and missing action locator
methods.medium_trigger: A required subtask has no clear supported path
methods.fix: Expose the documented path without inventing product capability
methods.verify: Complete the mapped subtasks with representative data

methods.prerequisites: A runnable task or stepwise prototype
methods.inspect: At each step ask whether a novice would know the goal, see the action, recognize it and understand feedback
methods.evidence: Step sequence, expected cue, actual cue and capture
methods.medium_trigger: A necessary step has an unrecognizable action or ambiguous feedback
methods.fix: Repair the signifier or feedback at that step
methods.verify: Replay from a fresh start without relying on prior discovery

methods.prerequisites: Visible states and task context
methods.inspect: Inspect system status, real-world match, control, consistency, prevention, recognition, efficiency, minimalism, recovery and help
methods.evidence: Named heuristic, state, observation and user consequence
methods.medium_trigger: A concrete heuristic violation creates repeatable friction
methods.fix: Apply the relevant control, feedback or recovery pattern
methods.verify: Re-exercise the violated heuristic in affected states

methods.prerequisites: Comparable deterministic task paths
methods.inspect: Count explicit operators, context switches and repeated entry; label time estimates as predictions
methods.evidence: Operator sequence and assumptions; no invented measured times
methods.medium_trigger: An avoidable repeated operation burdens the documented frequent task
methods.fix: Remove redundant steps while retaining required choices
methods.verify: Compare operators and complete both novice and expert paths

methods.prerequisites: Known start, end and handoff points
methods.inspect: Trace the goal across screens and identify lost context, dead ends and repeated information
methods.evidence: Journey steps and broken handoff capture
methods.medium_trigger: A handoff loses necessary state or progress
methods.fix: Carry state and expose return or continuation paths
methods.verify: Complete the journey across the handoff and back

methods.prerequisites: Navigation labels and destination content
methods.inspect: Compare each label and preview to its actual destination and the user goal
methods.evidence: Link label, destination and mismatch
methods.medium_trigger: A label predicts a materially different destination
methods.fix: Use specific task language and accurate previews
methods.verify: Follow the renamed link and inspect destination context

methods.prerequisites: A navigable hierarchy
methods.inspect: Inspect location cues, consistent navigation, back behavior, deep links and return paths
methods.evidence: Route map, current-location cue and navigation trace
methods.medium_trigger: A user cannot identify location or return to the parent task
methods.fix: Add stable location and return cues
methods.verify: Open a deep link, move between levels and return

methods.prerequisites: Actual interface copy and business meaning
methods.inspect: Check action labels, instructions, terminology, errors, empty states and help at point of need
methods.evidence: Exact text, location and missing decision information
methods.medium_trigger: Copy omits information needed for a correct action
methods.fix: Rewrite around the action and consequence with verified product facts
methods.verify: Complete the task using the revised copy

methods.prerequisites: Audience and representative text
methods.inspect: Inspect jargon, sentence burden, ambiguous pronouns and inconsistent terms; readability scores are hints
methods.evidence: Quoted passage, audience mismatch and proposed wording
methods.medium_trigger: Language demonstrably obscures a required decision
methods.fix: Use the audience vocabulary and one consistent term
methods.verify: Check the rewritten instruction against the actual task

methods.prerequisites: Complex options or staged task
methods.inspect: Check which choices appear at each decision and whether defaults hide necessary information
methods.evidence: Decision inventory and initial versus expanded state
methods.medium_trigger: An avoidable option burden obscures the main action, or needed detail is hidden
methods.fix: Group secondary choices while keeping required information discoverable
methods.verify: Complete both default and advanced tasks

methods.prerequisites: Rendered capture with known primary task
methods.inspect: Blur or squint at the capture; compare dominant blocks and action emphasis to the intended hierarchy
methods.evidence: Capture region and explicit emphasis comparison
methods.medium_trigger: A secondary element dominates the documented primary action
methods.fix: Adjust scale, position or emphasis using existing design tokens
methods.verify: Inspect a new full-size and blurred capture

methods.prerequisites: Real headings, lists, actions and reading direction
methods.inspect: Trace task-based scanning landmarks; inspect headings, front-loaded labels and chunk boundaries; do not prescribe universal F/Z patterns
methods.evidence: Reading direction, sought item and competing landmarks
methods.medium_trigger: The sought item cannot be distinguished from competing content
methods.fix: Clarify headings, grouping and task-relevant emphasis
methods.verify: Locate the same information in fresh desktop and narrow captures

methods.prerequisites: Rendered related and unrelated elements
methods.inspect: Check proximity, similarity, enclosure and continuity against semantic relationships
methods.evidence: Related element locators and spacing/enclosure evidence
methods.medium_trigger: Visual grouping suggests the wrong association
methods.fix: Align visual groups with semantic relationships
methods.verify: Recheck both intended group and adjacent unrelated items

methods.prerequisites: Rendered geometry or design specification
methods.inspect: Measure shared edges, baselines, column behavior and alignment at breakpoints
methods.evidence: Bounding boxes, token/spec comparison and capture
methods.medium_trigger: Misalignment weakens the intended group or disrupts reading
methods.fix: Use a shared grid or alignment rule
methods.verify: Measure the same edges after rendering

methods.prerequisites: Representative dense and sparse states
methods.inspect: Inspect spacing scale, line separation, whitespace and density against task needs
methods.evidence: Measured gaps and affected content relationships
methods.medium_trigger: Inconsistent spacing blurs boundaries or hides important content
methods.fix: Apply consistent spacing without sacrificing required information
methods.verify: Render long, empty and dense content variants

methods.prerequisites: Text at real rendered size
methods.inspect: Check hierarchy, measure, leading, wrapping, truncation, rag, stranded headings, glyphs and numeric alignment
methods.evidence: Text region, computed type values and visible defect
methods.medium_trigger: Type treatment causes ambiguous hierarchy, truncation or reading friction
methods.fix: Repair type tokens, line behavior or numeric style
methods.verify: Render long labels, paragraphs and changing numeric values

methods.prerequisites: Actual themes and state colors
methods.inspect: Compare palette roles across actions, errors, success, selected and disabled states
methods.evidence: State-to-color map and conflicting roles
methods.medium_trigger: The same color implies contradictory actionable states
methods.fix: Use consistent semantic tokens and add non-color cues
methods.verify: Compare all affected states in each supported theme

methods.prerequisites: Reliable computed foreground/background and text size/weight
methods.inspect: Measure applicable SC 1.4.3 ratios including compositing, gradients and states; check exceptions
methods.evidence: Unrounded ratio, computed colors, font properties and criterion
methods.medium_trigger: Applicable text misses its required contrast threshold
methods.fix: Change semantic colors within the brand palette
methods.verify: Remeasure every affected theme/state after render

methods.prerequisites: Control/state/graphic geometry and computed colors
methods.inspect: Measure SC 1.4.11 information needed to identify controls, states and graphical objects; check exceptions
methods.evidence: Required boundary or indicator, adjacent colors and measured ratio
methods.medium_trigger: A required non-text visual misses applicable 3:1 contrast
methods.fix: Repair boundary or indicator contrast without changing meaning
methods.verify: Measure the affected adjacent pairs in every state

methods.prerequisites: Status, links, charts or validation indicators
methods.inspect: Remove hue as a cue and inspect whether text, shape or pattern retains meaning; simulations are aids
methods.evidence: State capture and non-color cue inventory
methods.medium_trigger: Meaning or required action depends only on hue
methods.fix: Add a text, icon, shape or pattern cue
methods.verify: Verify meaning in grayscale and with accessible names

methods.prerequisites: Actual icons, labels and interactions
methods.inspect: Compare each symbol to its action, discoverability and labeling; inspect hover and touch access
methods.evidence: Icon locator, visible label and action outcome
methods.medium_trigger: An ambiguous icon masks a necessary action
methods.fix: Add a clear label or use the established symbol
methods.verify: Perform the action with pointer, touch and keyboard where supported

methods.prerequisites: Images or media present
methods.inspect: Inspect cropping, resolution, aspect ratio, relevance and meaningful alternatives
methods.evidence: Asset locator, rendered crop and alternative text
methods.medium_trigger: Cropping, distortion or missing alternatives obscures important meaning
methods.fix: Repair fit or supply accurate meaningful alternatives
methods.verify: Render relevant sizes and inspect the accessibility representation

methods.prerequisites: Interactive controls and their outcomes
methods.inspect: Inspect what looks clickable, what is clickable, state feedback and control-to-result mapping
methods.evidence: Control locator and observed activation
methods.medium_trigger: A necessary control hides its affordance or suggests the wrong outcome
methods.fix: Use established control semantics and clear signifiers
methods.verify: Activate and observe the mapped outcome in supported modalities

methods.prerequisites: Pointer target geometry
methods.inspect: Measure interactive hit areas, spacing and movement demands; apply SC 2.5.8 exceptions before failing
methods.evidence: Actual hit rectangles, nearby targets and exception analysis
methods.medium_trigger: A target fails the applicable minimum or creates observed acquisition friction
methods.fix: Increase hit area or spacing while preserving nearby interactions
methods.verify: Measure hit testing and replay pointer/touch activation

methods.prerequisites: Runnable interactive target
methods.inspect: Complete scoped tasks using keyboard only, including escape, shortcuts and hidden controls
methods.evidence: Key sequence, focus positions and task results
methods.medium_trigger: A required operation cannot be completed by keyboard
methods.fix: Use operable native controls or correct documented key behavior
methods.verify: Replay the entire task without pointer assistance

methods.prerequisites: Runnable overlays, navigation or dynamic updates
methods.inspect: Inspect visible focus, order, obscuration, traps, dialog entry/return and focus after deletion
methods.evidence: Focus trace and captures at state transitions
methods.medium_trigger: Focus is lost, trapped, invisible or obscured in a required task
methods.fix: Repair focus ownership, order and return behavior
methods.verify: Replay open, interact, close, navigate and remove sequences

methods.prerequisites: Runnable inputs and submission flow
methods.inspect: Exercise valid, invalid, missing, pasted, autofilled and server-rejected inputs; inspect retained values and linked errors
methods.evidence: Input cases, errors and retained-data observation
methods.medium_trigger: An error gives no actionable recovery or loses entered data
methods.fix: Associate errors, preserve values and offer a valid correction
methods.verify: Correct errors and submit successfully without re-entering unaffected data

methods.prerequisites: Component state machine and runtime
methods.inspect: Enumerate and exercise empty, loading, success, error, disabled, partial and permission states where present
methods.evidence: Transition matrix with reachable states and captures
methods.medium_trigger: A supported state lacks an actionable or truthful presentation
methods.fix: Implement the missing transition or state-specific feedback
methods.verify: Replay the transition including rapid and repeated actions

methods.prerequisites: Runtime accessibility tree or native equivalent
methods.inspect: Inspect roles, names, values, relationships, landmarks, headings, alternatives and status exposure
methods.evidence: Tree nodes matched to visible controls and task
methods.medium_trigger: A necessary control or update has missing or misleading semantic information
methods.fix: Repair native semantics and associations before adding ARIA
methods.verify: Inspect the new tree and corresponding interaction

methods.prerequisites: Runnable target with scalable text
methods.inspect: Apply relevant WCAG resize/reflow/text-spacing conditions and inspect clipping, overlap and two-dimensional scrolling exceptions
methods.evidence: Viewport, zoom/text settings and rendered captures
methods.medium_trigger: Required content or controls disappear under applicable settings
methods.fix: Allow flexible sizing, wrapping and reflow
methods.verify: Repeat settings on all affected states; use standards reference

methods.prerequisites: Supported viewport range and realistic data
methods.inspect: Resize across breakpoints, vary orientation, keyboard/viewport height, long and short content and empty data
methods.evidence: Viewport/data matrix and captures of overflows
methods.medium_trigger: A supported viewport or content variant hides a necessary action
methods.fix: Repair responsive constraints rather than one screenshot offset
methods.verify: Rerender boundary widths and stress data on supported devices

methods.prerequisites: Text-bearing UI and locale requirements
methods.inspect: Exercise long translations or pseudolocalized strings, RTL when supported, locale formats and mixed-direction identifiers
methods.evidence: Locale settings, strings and captures
methods.medium_trigger: Supported locale content truncates meaning or reverses an essential relationship
methods.fix: Use flexible layout and locale-aware formatting without mistranslating facts
methods.verify: Replay representative tasks under supported locale variants

methods.prerequisites: Animation, autoplay, flashing or timed effects if present
methods.inspect: Inspect reduced-motion behavior, pause controls, disruptive transitions and applicable timing/flashing criteria
methods.evidence: Preference setting, animation behavior and recorded effect
methods.medium_trigger: Motion or timing prevents a scoped task or violates an applicable criterion
methods.fix: Respect preferences and provide pause, time or static alternatives
methods.verify: Repeat with reduced motion and relevant assistive settings

methods.prerequisites: Runnable asynchronous operations
methods.inspect: Trace action to visible acknowledgement, progress, completion and cancellation under controlled delay; distinguish lab from field metrics
methods.evidence: Timestamped interaction trace, environment and state captures
methods.medium_trigger: Delay leaves the user uncertain or permits duplicate harmful actions
methods.fix: Give truthful acknowledgement, progress and cancellability where supported
methods.verify: Repeat delayed, completed and cancelled operations

methods.prerequisites: Safe test environment with network control
methods.inspect: Interrupt, time out and restore requests; inspect partial progress, retries, duplicate prevention and retained input
methods.evidence: Fault sequence, request outcome and recovery trace
methods.medium_trigger: Recoverable connection trouble loses user work or creates duplicate actions
methods.fix: Preserve state and make retry/resume behavior explicit
methods.verify: Repeat interruption and recovery without duplicate effects

methods.prerequisites: Reversible fixture or safe test data
methods.inspect: Exercise cancellation, confirmation, undo and recovery appropriate to consequences; never destroy real user data
methods.evidence: Before/after state and recovery result in safe fixture
methods.medium_trigger: An avoidable action causes loss without proportionate warning or recovery
methods.fix: Use specific consequences and a verified recovery mechanism
methods.verify: Cancel and undo with safe fixtures and verify restored state

methods.prerequisites: Actual choices, defaults, pricing or permissions
methods.inspect: Inspect hidden costs, forced actions, asymmetric acceptance/cancellation and misleading emphasis; do not invent legal conclusions
methods.evidence: Exact wording, choice paths and actual consequences
methods.medium_trigger: The interface materially misleads or obstructs an intended choice
methods.fix: Present honest equivalent choices and disclose consequences
methods.verify: Complete acceptance, rejection and cancellation paths

methods.prerequisites: Documented tokens, components or established peer screens
methods.inspect: Compare component variants and interaction conventions to the current system; distinguish intentional exceptions
methods.evidence: Token/component reference and rendered mismatch
methods.medium_trigger: Unjustified inconsistency makes equivalent actions behave or look different
methods.fix: Reuse the established token or component
methods.verify: Check changed instances and shared-component consumers

methods.prerequisites: Supported platforms and runnable builds
methods.inspect: Replay scoped interactions across the documented engines/platforms and compare conventions; fetch current API docs for fixes
methods.evidence: Platform/build/browser identity and observed differences
methods.medium_trigger: A supported platform loses a necessary interaction or meaningful information
methods.fix: Use supported behavior and platform conventions
methods.verify: Run the same scoped task on affected supported platforms

methods.prerequisites: Known product claims, brand and visible trust cues
methods.inspect: Compare authority cues, tone, data freshness and confidence to verified product capability; preference is not evidence
methods.evidence: Specific visual/copy cue and contradicted or unsupported implication
methods.medium_trigger: Presentation implies assurance or capability the product cannot support
methods.fix: Calibrate the cue or copy to the verified capability
methods.verify: Compare the revised presentation against actual behavior and evidence

methods.prerequisites: Screen reader or other required assistive technology and runnable target
methods.inspect: Complete tasks with actual assistive technology; DOM inspection is not a substitute
methods.evidence: Tool/version, spoken or other output and action transcript
methods.medium_trigger: Required information or operation is inaccessible in actual use
methods.fix: Repair semantics, announcements or focus and retain native behavior
methods.verify: Repeat the task with the same assistive technology

methods.prerequisites: Charts, dashboards or data tables
methods.inspect: Inspect scales, units, baselines, encodings, legends, uncertainty, sorting and textual equivalents
methods.evidence: Underlying values, chart encoding and rendered comparison
methods.medium_trigger: Encoding misleads a decision or hides essential data
methods.fix: Use truthful encodings, labels and an accessible data alternative
methods.verify: Compare rendered conclusions to known fixture values

methods.prerequisites: Search with representative queries and expected results
methods.inspect: Run known-item, exploratory, typo, no-result and filter tasks against a labeled small query set
methods.evidence: Query/result judgments, corpus context and action trace
methods.medium_trigger: A representative task cannot locate known relevant content or recover
methods.fix: Repair search labeling, query handling, result context or filters
methods.verify: Repeat the fixed query set; do not claim corpus-wide relevance

methods.prerequisites: Drag, multi-point, path-based or hover interactions
methods.inspect: Exercise pointer cancellation and alternatives to dragging, gestures and hover-only information
methods.evidence: Modality, gesture and equivalent action trace
methods.medium_trigger: An essential action requires an unsupported precise gesture or lacks required alternative
methods.fix: Offer a simple equivalent control and robust cancellation
methods.verify: Complete the task using each supported input method

methods.prerequisites: AI or agent controls with streaming/uncertain output
methods.inspect: Inspect stop/retry, partial output, source access, uncertainty, confirmations and recoverable model failure
methods.evidence: Actual model/fixture state and visible control/outcome trace
methods.medium_trigger: The UI presents unfinished output as final or hides consequential user control
methods.fix: Expose truthful state and user steering without inventing confidence
methods.verify: Replay slow, failed, interrupted and completed output

methods.prerequisites: First-use, help or setup path
methods.inspect: Start from a reset safe state; inspect prerequisites, optional tours, progressive help and resumption
methods.evidence: Fresh-state task sequence and discovered dependency
methods.medium_trigger: A new user cannot reach initial value using available guidance
methods.fix: Make prerequisites and next useful action explicit
methods.verify: Complete setup and resume after interruption

methods.prerequisites: Login, recovery, expiration or permissions present
methods.inspect: Exercise denied/granted/expired states, accessible authentication and return to intended destination
methods.evidence: Safe fixture identities, state transition and preserved destination
methods.medium_trigger: Access recovery loses task context or presents an inaccessible required challenge
methods.fix: Repair recovery, alternatives and return navigation without weakening access policy
methods.verify: Repeat each permission/auth state with safe accounts

methods.prerequisites: Notifications, alerts or concurrent tasks present
methods.inspect: Inspect urgency, interruption, duplication, dismissal, persistence and return to prior work
methods.evidence: Alert trace, user setting and interrupted task state
methods.medium_trigger: An alert interrupts or disappears in a way that causes a missed required action
methods.fix: Match presentation and persistence to verified urgency
methods.verify: Trigger, dismiss and return while checking retained task state

methods.prerequisites: Authorized sessions with representative participants and task protocol
methods.inspect: Observe task attempts without coaching; record failures and separate observation from interpretation
methods.evidence: Participant/task/session identifiers, observed actions and outcomes
methods.medium_trigger: A documented usability failure blocks or burdens the intended task
methods.fix: Repair the supported root cause, not an invented participant preference
methods.verify: Retest the affected task with authorized participants or mark research validation pending

methods.prerequisites: Authorized recorded sessions and predetermined tasks
methods.inspect: Review completion, failure, abandonment and context across actual sessions
methods.evidence: Session/task traces, denominators and collection context
methods.medium_trigger: Observed task failures support a repeatable interface defect
methods.fix: Repair the observed cause and preserve the task protocol
methods.verify: Run a comparable authorized follow-up or leave the outcome unverified

methods.prerequisites: Real participants, task and first-action recordings
methods.inspect: Compare the first chosen action to the task path, retaining alternatives and sample limits
methods.evidence: Actual first actions and denominators
methods.medium_trigger: Participants consistently begin down a misleading path in the supplied evidence
methods.fix: Repair the misleading label or placement
methods.verify: Collect authorized comparable first-action evidence; do not simulate users

methods.prerequisites: Authorized timed exposures and participant responses
methods.inspect: Expose the interface for the protocol duration, then ask recall/comprehension questions
methods.evidence: Timed protocol, participant responses and scoring rule
methods.medium_trigger: Observed responses miss essential identity, purpose or next action
methods.fix: Repair the observed hierarchy or message gap
methods.verify: Repeat timed protocol; an expert glance is not a timed participant test

methods.prerequisites: Participants, hierarchy and navigation tasks
methods.inspect: Analyze destination success, directness and incorrect branches without visual interface cues
methods.evidence: Task paths, hierarchy version and denominators
methods.medium_trigger: The supplied study shows a confusing category or hierarchy
methods.fix: Repair labels or hierarchy consistent with the study
methods.verify: Repeat the same task design on the changed tree

methods.prerequisites: Authorized participant grouping data and content inventory
methods.inspect: Analyze categories, naming and disagreement; distinguish open, closed and hybrid protocols
methods.evidence: Card set, grouping records, participant context and analysis
methods.medium_trigger: The current taxonomy conflicts with supported participant groupings
methods.fix: Revise the category hypothesis without claiming universal agreement
methods.verify: Validate the revised taxonomy with a subsequent authorized sort or tree test

methods.prerequisites: Authorized observations in the actual usage environment
methods.inspect: Study real task conditions, interruptions, workarounds and physical constraints
methods.evidence: Observed environment/task notes with privacy protection
methods.medium_trigger: A real contextual constraint makes the current UI impractical
methods.fix: Repair the UI support for that observed constraint
methods.verify: Validate in the same context or report the remaining evidence gap

methods.prerequisites: Authorized cooperative observation and participant explanation
methods.inspect: Observe work while asking about actions, tools and constraints; separate explanation from behavior
methods.evidence: Session notes linking observed actions and explanations
methods.medium_trigger: The UI conflicts with an evidenced essential work practice
methods.fix: Support the practice without generalizing one account to everyone
methods.verify: Revisit the affected practice with authorized participants

methods.prerequisites: Consented interview transcripts and research question
methods.inspect: Code participant statements, needs and contradictions; do not infer task success from preferences
methods.evidence: Quoted anonymized statements, sample and theme-to-evidence links
methods.medium_trigger: An evidenced need has a concrete unmet interface consequence
methods.fix: Form and implement a bounded design response to that need
methods.verify: Validate the response with behavior evidence; interviews alone cannot prove usability

methods.prerequisites: Authorized longitudinal entries and context
methods.inspect: Analyze recurring friction, delayed use and cross-session continuity
methods.evidence: Dated entries, participant context and recurrence evidence
methods.medium_trigger: Repeated use reveals a supported continuity or recovery defect
methods.fix: Repair the longitudinal friction while preserving user state
methods.verify: Review comparable follow-up entries or keep validation pending

methods.prerequisites: Actual calibrated eye-tracking recordings
methods.inspect: Analyze fixation and attention for the task with calibration and sample limits; gaze does not prove comprehension
methods.evidence: Device/protocol, gaze data, task and analysis
methods.medium_trigger: Study evidence shows essential information was repeatedly missed
methods.fix: Repair the relevant emphasis or arrangement
methods.verify: Repeat calibrated task evidence; do not manufacture heatmaps from screenshots

methods.prerequisites: Authorized survey responses and instrument
methods.inspect: Score the supplied instrument correctly; distinguish attitudes from task performance and inspect response bias
methods.evidence: Instrument, responses, scoring method and uncertainty
methods.medium_trigger: A reliable survey signal plus evidence identifies an actionable interface problem
methods.fix: Repair the corroborated issue rather than optimize an invented score
methods.verify: Repeat comparable measurement; do not invent SUS or other responses

methods.prerequisites: Existing authorized instrumentation and comparable cohorts
methods.inspect: Inspect step conversion, error and abandonment with denominators, event definitions and confounders
methods.evidence: Event schema, time window, cohort and counts
methods.medium_trigger: Valid data identifies a supported task drop-off with an actionable UI cause
methods.fix: Repair the corroborated friction; do not infer causation from a funnel alone
methods.verify: Compare equivalent cohorts and retain uncertainty

methods.prerequisites: Authorized experiment with hypothesis, allocation and guardrails
methods.inspect: Inspect randomization, metrics, sample, uncertainty and harms; no automatic production experiment
methods.evidence: Experiment protocol, assignment and measured outcomes
methods.medium_trigger: Credible results establish a meaningful usability loss without a guardrail benefit
methods.fix: Apply the supported treatment when authorized
methods.verify: Confirm guardrails and equivalent follow-up; do not claim uplift without data

methods.prerequisites: Comparable scripted participant tasks and baseline
methods.inspect: Compare completion, errors and time under the same protocol; distinguish learning and sample effects
methods.evidence: Baseline/current task results, sample and uncertainty
methods.medium_trigger: Comparable evidence reveals a meaningful regression or deficit
methods.fix: Repair the supported source of performance loss
methods.verify: Repeat the benchmark under comparable conditions

methods.prerequisites: Participant responses to design alternatives and attributes
methods.inspect: Analyze stated associations and preference with audience and task context
methods.evidence: Alternatives, attribute set and actual response distribution
methods.medium_trigger: Supported associations conflict with a documented product requirement
methods.fix: Adjust the implicated visual cue within the design constraints
methods.verify: Collect comparable responses; do not equate preference with usability

methods.prerequisites: Authorized co-design outputs and participant rationale
methods.inspect: Study constructed arrangements and stated trade-offs as design hypotheses
methods.evidence: Participant artifacts, rationale and analysis
methods.medium_trigger: A supported essential need has no representation in the interface
methods.fix: Prototype the relevant hypothesis without treating votes as proof
methods.verify: Test the resulting task behavior with participants

methods.prerequisites: Authorized group transcript and topic guide
methods.inspect: Analyze shared language and perceptions while recording dominance and group bias
methods.evidence: Anonymized transcript and theme evidence
methods.medium_trigger: A corroborated perception problem has a concrete actionable interface cause
methods.fix: Repair the supported communication issue; do not infer ease of use
methods.verify: Validate independently with task or comprehension evidence

methods.prerequisites: Authorized concept presentation and participant responses
methods.inspect: Inspect understanding and relevance of the core value proposition, not detailed task usability
methods.evidence: Presented concept, questions and actual responses
methods.medium_trigger: Users misunderstand the documented value proposition in supplied evidence
methods.fix: Repair the concept explanation or bounded interface presentation
methods.verify: Repeat comprehension testing; do not invent demand or market fit

methods.prerequisites: Existing authorized feedback records
methods.inspect: Code repeated issues, duplicates, affected versions and selection bias
methods.evidence: Anonymized records, affected version and reproducible theme
methods.medium_trigger: Feedback identifies a reproducible UI defect in the current version
methods.fix: Repair the confirmed defect and retain unconfirmed reports as hypotheses
methods.verify: Reproduce on the current build and test the repair

methods.prerequisites: Existing consented path events and event definitions
methods.inspect: Analyze loops, detours and backtracking while accounting for user goals and missing events
methods.evidence: Versioned event sequences, cohorts and denominators
methods.medium_trigger: Valid paths corroborate an avoidable navigational detour
methods.fix: Repair the path or cue linked to the observed detour
methods.verify: Compare equivalent path tasks without treating shorter as inherently better

methods.prerequisites: Documented cross-channel service handoffs and evidence
methods.inspect: Map visible UI promises to backstage and human handoffs; inspect ownership, delay and recovery
methods.evidence: Blueprint, service state and confirmed handoff outcomes
methods.medium_trigger: A UI promise cannot be fulfilled by the documented service handoff
methods.fix: Repair expectations and supported handoff/recovery information
methods.verify: Trace the handoff end to end without sending unauthorized messages
